B.name: SemIf-style direct native-logit readout, zero learned parameters
B.serialization: identical State:/Question type:/Question: prefix segments as predict_toy_decisions.prepare_examples; single-pass 'Candidates:' block; closing marker 'Decision:' (primary) and 'Answer:' (elicitation diagnostic)

labels.choice: A..Z -> criteria keys in insertion order

B.over_26_choice_fallback: per-candidate leaf path (byte-identical to prepare_examples leaves); scalar = EOS logit at the pre-EOS decision position; softmax over candidates. Contract-preserving for k<=255; documented limitation: EOS-acceptance is a path-plausibility proxy, not a label readout. First-token-of-option-text was considered and rejected: first tokens can collide across candidates, silently merging option mass.

C.name: LoRA r16 (alpha32 dropout0.05 lr5e-5) on pinned base + minimal pointer head (T9b Option B, minimal form)
C.head: query = hidden at anchor path 'prefix + Decision: + EOS'; keys = per-candidate leaf hidden states; score_i = (Wq q).(Wk h_i)/sqrt(128); boolean uses a learned zero-init null key for the 'false' slot
C.training: corpus v3 train1080, gold_distribution CE, batch 16, microbatch 4 x 16384 tokens, max_length 2048, 300 steps, 12 head-warmup steps, dev-only best-step selection, MPS/FP32
